notes.title: Upload VR Showcase Summer 2023
notes.content:
We are thrilled to announce "Puttzzle" has been showcased at the Upload VR Showcase Summer 2023: a big shoutout to Uploadvr for providing a platform to showcase amazing VR games and connecting gamers!

If you haven't had the chance to watch trailers of "Teahouse of Souls" and "Puttzzle," make sure to watch the UVR summer showcase!

notes.title: "Puttlzzle" has been released!
notes.content:
Dear fans of Pixelity,

The virgin flight of the Pixelity Gamelab, exclusively in chage of hyper-casual genre is begun; "Puttlzzle" has been officially released!

We hope every VR player could enjoy this fun yet sophisticated VR game.

We wish this could be a little present in your daily lives. 

Distinctive reactions and your careful controls would provide a new type of satisfactions

Thank you and enjoy!
